parole.significato: caracal (a type of cat native to Southern Africa, West Asia, and parts of Central and South Asia, Caracal caracal)
parole.testo: Borrowed from French caracal, Ottoman Turkish قره قولاق (kara kulak, literally “black ear”), a calque of Classical Persian سیاهگوش (siyāh-gōš). Compare English caracal and modern Turkish karakulak.
